items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: >> [Floyd Levin] I thought, didn't Johnny St. Cyr used to work for Frank Early if I remember right?

ctx.x: I thought, didn't Johnny St. Cyr used to work for Frank Early if I remember right?
Alright, we can turn it off. Tell me about, did you ever know Buddy Bolden? Did you ever hear him?

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: But Johnny St. Cyr was playing banjo-guitar.

ctx.x: So, then, when Johnny St. Cyr plays the banjo with the Hot Five recordings, about 1924, with Louis Armstrong, then what was that about?
Oh, well, banjos was played. They was all playing banjos after that. But Johnny St. Cyr was playing banjo-guitar.
